osm_report.threat_description:
Infostealer targeting Minecraft accounts, exfiltrating to a Discord webhook (Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:22). Payload in Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py.
Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:759) and sends data out (Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:22).
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: "launcher_accounts.json" "api/webhooks".
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py
- Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:759) and sends data out (Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:22).
- Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:759: reads Minecraft launcher account stores (Microsoft refresh and access tokens)
- Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:22: hardcoded Discord webhook, the drop point for stolen data
- Ddos Ripper/Ddos Ripper v2.1.py:129: runs shell commands through os.system (+6 more)
